values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; campsites can be booked for today. 'Campsites require a 2-night minimum stay all season'; a 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 7 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. Cabins need 2 nights off-peak and 7 or 14 nights in peak season.

summary: ReserveAmerica confirms 2027 season May 14-Oct 10 (unchanged), reservable (booking verified), showers, dump. Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum all season (1 night within 7 days), 14-night max, 30 A max (18 electric sites). Changed sites count 76 -> 68 (RA list) and max_rig_ft 30 -> 35 (one 35-ft site; 20 at 30 ft). Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of site/hookup/booking text.
